data.narrative:
Limelight Steel is a pre-seed stage climate and energy company founded by Olivia Dippo and Andy Zhao. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis was the applicable valuation method. Using total capital raised of $6M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from pre-seed to seed stage yields an implied valuation of $15M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable; while 8 same-sector comparables exist, none met the screening criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier, producing insufficient datapoints for reliable calibration.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $12.75M to $17.25M, with a median point estimate of $15M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty around stage-progression assumptions—the 2.5x multiplier reflects typical venture step-ups but may not capture company-specific technical risk, market timing, or capital efficiency. Resolution of early technical milestones and customer validation would materially inform the appropriate positioning within this range.
